title: Expansion of covectors in the rotated basis Q^*dx^α (Simon 6, §1 and proof of 2.36)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every linear isometry Q of ℝ^P and every n-covector φ on ℝ^P, φ = Σ_{α∈I(n,P)} φ(Q^{−1}e_{α(0)}, …, Q^{−1}e_{α(n−1)})·Q^*dx^α. Here I(n,P) = SimonMultiIndex n P is the set of strictly increasing maps Fin n → Fin P, e_k is the k-th standard basis vector of ℝ^P, and Q^*dx^α := wedgeCovectors n (fun i => x^{α(i)}∘Q) is the wedge of the 1-covectors x ↦ (Qx)_{α(i)}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P) (φ : Covector (Eucl P) n), φ = ∑ α : SimonMultiIndex n P, φ (fun i => Q.symm (EuclideanSpace.single (α i) (1 : ℝ))) • wedgeCovectors n (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj (α i) : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (Q : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl P))
